name: Earthworm Girl
source:
Similar to a normal earthworm, her entire body is slimy. Though she usually lives underground, Earthworm Girls are known to come above ground to attack men when they're hungry.

With their staple food being male semen, they are able to both absorb it through their skin and to directly suck it out with their tails. Their basic attack pattern is to wrap their bodies around their catch and seal off their movements as they feed. If their prey is combative, they can use their tails to forcefully suck out their food by forcing pleasure onto their catch.

As with feeding, when they wish to mate they use their tails. When they are finished feeding, in most cases they release their catch, however cases have been reported of men being brought back to the Earthworm Girl's underground nest to be kept as a mate if the male catches her interest.

[From In-game Monsterpedia]
